title: Return Policy — Electronics (Laptops, Headphones)
text: Items in the laptops and headphones categories may be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund, provided the item is unused, in original packaging, and all accessories are included. Opened software licenses and consumable accessories (ear tips, cables sold separately) are non-returnable once opened. Defective items reported within the 30-day window are eligible for a free replacement or refund, buyer's choice. Return shipping is free for defective items; for change-of-mind returns the customer covers return shipping.
